root_cause.metadata_cover_index_mismatch: The dynamic plaque and covers were independent of the four-book row baked into premium-library-reference-exact-1440.webp. The undersized translucent mask allowed the baked Devdas cover to remain visible beneath metadata for another live slide.

repair.hero_only_exclusion: Explicit hero_featured_slugs omits devdas while sprint1_active_slugs and literary shelf membership retain it.
repair.layout: Desktop plaque and 3-D stage are separate grid regions; tablet and mobile stack without absolute plaque offsets.
repair.reference_art_treatment: A local catalog-region mask covers the complete baked four-book row before canonical interactive covers render.

limitations: The supplied desktop reference bitmap still contains the original four books internally; its complete catalog region is visually replaced without modifying the protected tablet, phone, benefits panel, copy, CTA, or feature rail artwork.
The local static build cannot reach production public settings, so the browser records the expected local Network Error warning; no carousel console errors were observed.
The repository exposes no standalone lint or TypeScript typecheck script. The CRACO production build completed with its configured compile-time checks.
